output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares the submitted ΔT and ΔS curves against the paper‑reported results, using absolute tolerances (2 K for ΔT, 2 J/kg·K for ΔS) and a relative tolerance on the peak ΔT at 500 kV/cm. Qualitative sign checks are also performed.
